svg.title: CreativeAuth user flow diagram
svg.desc: A flowchart showing the full user journey through CreativeAuth including registration, login, dashboard, and sign out flows

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What happens when a user first opens CreativeAuth?')
sendPrompt('What does the LoginSignupToggler component do?')
sendPrompt('What fields does the SignUp page have?')
sendPrompt('How does password confirmation work on the sign up page?')
sendPrompt('What happens when a user registers in CreativeAuth?')
sendPrompt('What happens after a user successfully registers?')
sendPrompt('What fields does the SignIn page have?')
sendPrompt('How does the login API call work in CreativeAuth?')
sendPrompt('How does JWT work in CreativeAuth?')
sendPrompt('What can users do on the dashboard in CreativeAuth?')
sendPrompt('What does the CreativeAuth dashboard show?')
sendPrompt('What happens when a user signs out of CreativeAuth?')
